postgres.note: A real local Postgres 16 instance was available this session (simply not started in the prior 3F.1.2 session, not fundamentally unavailable). Started, confirmed fully migrated (`npx prisma migrate status`: up to date, 25 migrations), used for all real-DB-backed test workstreams.
postgres.materialityToAudit: This materially changes what can be PROVEN vs. NOT_PROVEN_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED compared to the prior 3F.1.2 phase's report, which had no reachable DB. Multiple guarantees in this audit (tenant/instrument isolation at the DB layer, cascade/FK behavior, real concurrent-write races, real duplicate-physical-occurrence persistence) are PROVEN against real Postgres, not merely reasoned about.

governingDocumentStalenessDisclosure.docs/HEADROOM-ROADMAP.md: Confirmed STALE: still reads 'Current phase: Phase 2 complete... recommended Phase 3A' and has not been updated since first written, despite 9+ subsequent phases (3A-3F.1.2) having since completed and shipped, per `git log --follow -p`. Its claims about tenant/instrument isolation, caching, and reproducibility being 'BUILT' were treated in this audit as claims to independently re-verify, never as authoritative facts. Several claims were found to overstate reality (see PHASE1_MODEL_CLASSIFICATION and CACHE_INVALIDATION_ASSURANCE artifacts) and several held up under adversarial re-verification (effective-dating semantics).
